name: design-agent-skills
description: Design skills for AI agents to understand products, explore design options, and prepare clear implementation handoffs.

interface.longDescription:
DAS helps your agent investigate a design problem and develop alternatives you can compare. It works from your product sources and design system, then carries your approved choices into a clear implementation handoff. After the interface is built, the skills can help check it against those requirements.

Version 0.1.2 supports the documented Codex app and CLI workflows. Claude support is under development and is not part of this release.
defaultPrompt: Review this interface and recommend what to change.
Explore design directions for this product.
Check the implementation against the approved design.
